login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the mobile number you registered with.
login.registered: Your account is ready. Please sign in.
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: It takes one minute. Only farmers can register here.
register.passwordHelp: 8 to 64 characters, with at least one letter and one number. Do not use your mobile number.

validation.mobile: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
validation.password: Use 8 to 64 characters with at least one letter and one number.
validation.passwordEqualsMobile: Your password must not be your mobile number.
validation.fullName: Use letters, spaces and . ' - only (2 to 100 characters).

dashboard.shortcutsTitle: What would you like to do?
dashboard.newRecText: Enter your soil and weather details to see which crops may suit your land.
dashboard.historyText: Open crop advice you asked for before.
dashboard.chatText: Ask about crops, soil, pests and irrigation in your language.
dashboard.latestRecEmpty: You have not asked for crop advice yet.
dashboard.latestRecError: Your latest crop advice could not be loaded.

rec.newIntro: Fill in your soil test and local weather. If you do not know a value, ask your soil testing lab or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
rec.npkHelp: From your soil health card. Allowed: 0 to 300.
rec.phHelp: From your soil test. Most soils are between 5.5 and 8. Allowed: 3 to 10.
rec.temperatureHelp: Usual temperature during the season. Allowed: -5 to 55.
rec.rainfallHelp: Total expected rain in millimetres. Allowed: 0 to 5000.
rec.demoLabel: Demo model: trained on a public sample dataset. Not tested on real fields.
rec.statusCOMPLETED: Here are the crops that best match your details.
rec.statusLOW_CONFIDENCE: The model is not sure about these results. Please check with an expert before deciding.
rec.statusFAILED: We could not get crop advice this time. Please try again later.
rec.statusPENDING: Your advice is still being prepared.
rec.economicsNotAvailable: Cost and profit information is not available yet.
rec.warningINPUT_OUTSIDE_TRAINING_RANGE: Your {feature} is outside the values the model learned from, so results may be less reliable.
rec.warningLOW_MODEL_CONFIDENCE: The model is not confident for these inputs.
rec.historyEmpty: You have not asked for crop advice yet.

chat.title: Ask AgriGenius
chat.selectOrStart: Start a new conversation to ask your first question.
chat.emptyConversation: Ask anything about crops, soil, pests or irrigation. Answers come from verified farming guides.
chat.statusNO_SOURCES: No verified information was found for this question. Please contact your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
chat.statusREFUSED: This question is outside what AgriGenius can answer.
chat.statusFAILED: The answer could not be prepared. Please try again.
chat.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation and all its messages?
chat.disabledTitle: The chat assistant is not configured yet
chat.disabledText: Ask your administrator to set it up. You can still use crop advice.
chat.disclosure: Your questions are sent to an AI service to prepare answers. Do not share passwords or bank details.

errors.MALFORMED_REQUEST: Something was wrong with the request. Please check your details.
errors.ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with this mobile number or email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Mobile number or password is not correct.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this.

errors.ML_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Crop advice is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.ML_SERVICE_ERROR: Crop advice could not be prepared. Please try again later.
errors.CHAT_DISABLED: The chat assistant is not configured yet.
errors.CHAT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The chat assistant is busy or unavailable. Please try again soon.
